title: Style-Converter IR v2 (flat-list wire format with slot composition)
description: Machine-checked contract for the IR v2 JSON the converter emits by default (out/tmpOutput.json) and the three runtime style engines consume. v2 headline changes vs v1: (1) explicit irVersion/minReaderVersion envelope; (2) components is a FLAT array — `children` does not exist and its presence anywhere is a validation error; (3) child→parent composition via the structural `slot` object on the CHILD; (4) renames: _text→text, _pseudo→pseudos, _tag+_role→meta:{sourceTag?,role?}. STRICT at the envelope (document / component / slot / meta / selector / media / property wrapper): unknown keys at these levels are a schema violation. PERMISSIVE at property-data leaves (the 550-property value surface is documented, not enforced, in schema/spec/02-values.md) — EXCEPT the frozen composition structures (slot, meta) defined here. Ground truth: converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRWireV2.kt (IRComponentV2Serializer) and app/parsing/IRFlattener.kt.

irVersion.description: What the writer produced. Mandatory in v2 — a document without irVersion IS a v1 document and belongs to schema/ir-v1.schema.json (deprecation window only).

minReaderVersion.description: Oldest reader that can safely consume this document. A reader MUST refuse a document whose minReaderVersion exceeds what it implements (schema/spec/05-versioning.md).

components.description: FLAT component array — every component at every composition depth is a standalone entry. Sibling-order rule (schema/spec/03-children.md): relative order of entries sharing the same slot.parent IS the composition order (DOM order / Compose emission order / SwiftUI subview order); the converter's pre-order flattener (IRFlattener) guarantees each subtree is contiguous and order-stable vs the v1 nested form. May be empty for an empty input document.

keyframes.description: Document-level named keyframe sets (schema/spec/07-animations.md) — the wire twin of CSS @keyframes at-rules, which are document-scoped in CSS too. ADDITIVE minor-revision key (spec 05 change process): omitted entirely when the document declares no keyframes, so pre-motion documents are byte-identical and remain valid. Map: animation name (the custom-ident animation-name references) → offset-SORTED stop list. A component participates by carrying a normal AnimationName property whose identifier matches a key here; a DANGLING reference (no matching key) is a defined runtime no-op + PropertyTracker log, never an error — pinned by schema/conformance/fixtures/v2/keyframes.json. Ground truth: converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRWireV2.kt + CssParsing.convertKeyframesToIR.

fontFaces.description: Document-level webfont declarations (schema/spec/01-envelope.md §5) — the wire twin of CSS @font-face at-rules, which css-fonts-4 §4.1 scopes to the document's font database rather than to any element, exactly like @keyframes. ADDITIVE minor-revision key (spec 05 change process): omitted entirely when the document declares no deliverable face, so pre-wave-34 documents are byte-identical and remain valid. DROPPABLE: a reader that ignores this key renders every referencing element in its fallback face — degraded FIDELITY, never wrong structure — which is why entries carry a resource PATH the reader resolves against its own asset root instead of a payload it must decode. Order is DOCUMENT order and is meaningful: css-fonts-4 §4.1 makes a later face with the same (family, weight, style) win. Ground truth: converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRWireV2.kt + tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs scanFontFaces/resolveFontFaces.

fontFace.description: One @font-face declaration. STRICT envelope like every other v2 structure: exactly these four keys, of which family and src are required.

family.description: The `font-family` descriptor (css-fonts-4 §4.2), UNQUOTED — the authored <string> and <custom-ident> spellings ('test' and test) name the same family and normalize to the same string here, so a consumer never re-tokenises. Matched against the family names in element `font-family` values.

src.description: Path to the font FILE, relative to the corpus root of the pipeline that produced the document (the WPT mirror root, tools/wpt/, for the titan extractor). NOT a payload and NOT an absolute path: an absolute path would not survive the machine hop, and an inlined face costs 3–780 KB per entry against ~70 bytes here. Resolved from the FIRST url() arm of the css-fonts-4 §4.3 <font-src-list>; local() arms are never emitted (they name an installed system face, not a file), and the producer guarantees the file existed on disk at emit time. Consumers join it to their own asset root — the web harness serves it under /wpt-font/, a native reader would register the same file with Typeface.Builder / CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL.

weight.description: The `font-weight` descriptor AS AUTHORED (css-fonts-4 §4.4) — a single value ('700', 'bold') or a RANGE ('400 700'). NOT normalized to the IR's numeric 100–900 form: this is a descriptor on a face, not a computed property value, and a range has no numeric equivalent. Omitted = the §4.4 initial `normal`, never a silent 400.

style.description: The `font-style` descriptor AS AUTHORED (css-fonts-4 §4.5) — 'normal', 'italic', 'oblique', or an oblique angle/range ('oblique 20deg'). Omitted = the §4.5 initial `normal`.

component.description: One UI component. Serialized by IRComponentV2Serializer (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRWireV2.kt): id/name/properties always present; variables omitted when the component declares no custom properties; selectors/media omitted when empty; slot omitted for roots; text/pseudos omitted when null; meta omitted when it would be empty. `children` is deliberately ABSENT from this definition — additionalProperties:false makes any v2 document carrying a children key a hard validation error.

id.description: Unique component-instance id — uniqueness across the WHOLE document is a convert-time invariant (IRFlattener errors on duplicates because slot references would become ambiguous). Converter-generated form is '<lowercased-name>-<NNN>' (pre-order, zero-padded, shared counter).

name.description: Component type/class name (e.g. 'Button'). For components flattened from a nested authoring map, the map key becomes the name verbatim.

properties.description: Base properties. Always present, may be empty. ITEM-scoped properties (align-self, order, flex-grow/shrink/basis, grid-area/column/row, z-index, position+insets — the frozen list in schema/spec/03-children.md) are declared HERE on the child and routed to placement parent-data by the runtimes; CONTAINER-scoped properties are declared on the container. The wire carries no per-property scope byte — classification is derivable (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/PropertyScope.kt) and mirrored by each platform PropertyRegistry.

variables.description: CSS custom-property definitions declared on this component: '--name' → RAW declaration value, verbatim (css-variables-1 §2: names are case-SENSITIVE, values are untyped token streams until substitution — the empty string is a legal value). ADDITIVE minor-revision key (schema/spec/05-versioning.md change process): omitted entirely when the component declares no custom properties, so pre-variables documents are byte-identical and remain valid. var() REFERENCES do not live here — they stay unresolved inside normal property envelopes (null+original contract, spec 02); resolution order (element → slot-parent chain → fallback → guaranteed-invalid) is specified in schema/spec/02-values.md.

selectors.description: Pseudo-class buckets (:hover etc.). Omitted entirely when empty, so if present it is non-empty. Unchanged from v1.

media.description: Media-query buckets. Omitted entirely when empty, so if present it is non-empty. Unchanged from v1.

text.description: v2 rename of v1 `_text` — element text content, now a STRUCTURAL field (text is content, not a droppable hint). Omitted when null; empty string IS a legal emitted value ('extracted, was empty'). Leading text run renders before injected children (mixed-inline-content limitation carried over — spec 03 edge cases) UNLESS the component also carries `meta.runs`, which supersedes this field's placement (and only its placement — the string stays here verbatim for readers that drop meta).

pseudos.description: v2 rename of v1 `_pseudo` — generated-content slots ({before?, after?, marker?}), component-shaped payloads produced by the WPT extractor and forwarded verbatim by the converter. Pseudo nodes have no independent lifecycle and are NEVER flattened into the component list (spec 03 edge cases); the runtime treats them as implicit first/last entries of the host's open slot. Slot payloads validated permissively (extractor-owned shape).

meta.description: Droppable renderer hints, grouped (v2 home of v1 `_tag` and `_role`; `attrs` added wave-20, `decorations` wave-22, `markerText` wave-27, `runs` wave-32 and `lang` wave-37, all under the spec-05 additive meta-key rule). A consumer may ignore meta without correctness loss — unlike slot, which MUST round-trip; dropping `decorations` costs FIDELITY (a collapsed run paints the merged root-wins subset, never a superset), dropping `runs` costs inline ORDER (text first, then the children — the pre-wave-32 approximation the sibling `text` field still spells out), and dropping `lang` costs LOCALE fidelity (default-locale quote pairs and font fallback), not correctness. Omitted when no member has a value; if present it is non-empty and strict.

sourceTag.description: Originating HTML tag, lowercase (e.g. 'ol', 'li'). v2 home of v1 `_tag`; the converter now forwards it (the v1 pipeline dropped it — spec 04 history).

role.description: Role marker; only value emitted today is 'body-root'. v2 home of v1 `_role`. Open-ended string by design so future markers need no schema change.

attrs.description: wave-20 widget-identity attributes (v2 home of the extractor's `_attrs`, forwarded verbatim by the converter). Emitted for form/widget sourceTags (a/button/input/textarea/select/option/meter/progress) and — wave-27, the disjoint LIST-ORDINAL lane — for ol/li, whose markers depend on `start` (HTML §4.4.5) and per-item `value` (§4.4.8). ONLY present-in-source attributes among the twelve keys below appear. Value typing per the extractor contract (tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs widgetAttrsFor): checked/multiple/selected/disabled are presence-booleans (`true`); min/max — and value on meter/progress — are numbers where the source text is numeric; the ol/li lane is verbatim strings throughout; everything else is the verbatim source string. `src` is the wave-36 REPLACED-SOURCE lane, a third disjoint tag set (img/embed/object/video): the canonical key for the replaced element's image source whatever attribute spelled it in the markup (`src` on img/embed, `data` on object per HTML §4.8.7, `poster` on video per §4.8.9), carrying a PRODUCER-RELATIVE PATH or a `data:` URI — never a payload — on the same consumer-resolves contract as the document-level `fontFaces[].src`.

decorations.description: wave-22 per-line text decorations for a COLLAPSED inline run (v2 home of the extractor's `_decorations`, forwarded verbatim by the converter). Emitted ONLY when the extractor flattened a chain of decoration-only inline wrappers into one text run (tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs, the `_decorations` banner). ORDER is OUTERMOST-FIRST — the css-text-decor-3 §2.1 propagation order, so a descendant's line paints over its ancestors' where both land on the same row. AUTHORITATIVE when present: this is the COMPLETE line set for the run, and a reader that honours it MUST ignore the component's own text-decoration-line flags (the surviving flat longhands are a root-wins merged bag kept for readers that drop meta). `color` is the CSS colour token AS AUTHORED — NOT the IR sRGB leaf: the converter does not normalize it (schema/spec/04-metadata-fields.md), each runtime resolves the token with its own CSS token parser. Omitted `color` = `currentColor` (css-text-decor-3 §2.2 initial), never a silent drop.

line.description: Exactly ONE css-text-decor-3 §2.1 line keyword. An element declaring two (`text-decoration: underline overline`) contributes TWO entries sharing one colour, so consumers never re-tokenise. `blink` and `none` never appear (they paint nothing).

color.description: The decorating box's `text-decoration-color` as AUTHORED ('blue', '#00f', 'rgb(0,0,255)'). Absent = currentColor.

lang.description: wave-37 COMPUTED content language of this component's source element (v2 home of the extractor's `_lang`, forwarded verbatim by the converter). Already RESOLVED per HTML §3.2.6.2 — the element's own `lang`, else the nearest ancestor's, else the document element chain's (`<body lang>` nearer, `<html lang>` farther) — because the flat v2 component list has no parent edge for a reader to walk. VERBATIM as authored ('eN-Us' stays 'eN-Us'): BCP-47 matching is case-insensitive and subtag-truncating (RFC 4647 §2.1/§3.4) and every consumer lowercases at lookup, so canonicalising here would only lose the round-trip. Omitted when the document declares no language, which is the same state as 'use the consumer default locale'; HTML's explicit-unknown `lang=""` stops the resolution walk and likewise emits no key, so an empty attribute never falls through to an outer language. Droppable like every meta member — a reader that ignores it paints in its default locale, costing FIDELITY (`quotes: auto` picks the root CLDR pair instead of the language's; a generic font family resolves to the default-locale face) and never correctness. Consumers: web sets the DOM `lang` attribute and lets the browser's own CLDR quote table + font fallback engage; the generated-content bake (tools/titan/generated-content-bake.mjs) reads it to resolve css-content-3 §2.2.1 `quotes: auto` into literal marks for readers with no UA quote engine.

markerText.description: wave-27 RESOLVED list-marker string for one `<li>` (v2 home of the extractor's `_markerText`, forwarded verbatim by the converter). Emitted ONLY by the counter-style bake (tools/titan/counter-style-bake.mjs), which resolves css-counter-styles-3 §6 — the predefined table, the numeric/alphabetic/additive systems, §4 range checking and the §7.1.4 fallback chain — against the item's ordinal, itself derived from `<ol start>` / `<li value>` on meta.attrs. The string is representation + the style's §3.1.5 suffix WITHOUT its trailing space, because both native runtimes supply the marker-to-content gap themselves (Compose a trailing space + 4dp, SwiftUI an HStack spacing of 4). AUTHORITATIVE when present: a reader that honours it MUST NOT also synthesise a marker from the component's ListStyleType. Never emitted for the ordinal-independent §6.1 bullets, for `list-style-type: none`, or for a marker whose counter style the bake does not model — those cases carry no key at all and leave each runtime on its own table.

runs.description: wave-32 ORDERED inline-content list (v2 home of the extractor's `_runs`, forwarded verbatim by the converter). Emitted ONLY for a component whose own text INTERLEAVES with its kept element children — `the quick <u>brown</u> fox` where the `<u>` survives as a child — i.e. exactly the shape the single `text` string cannot express (tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs, the `_runs` banner; before wave-32 the extractor marked these components `inline-run-reordered` and shipped the concatenation). ORDER IS THE PAYLOAD: entries are in DOCUMENT order and each is EXACTLY ONE of `{text}` (an anonymous inline run) or `{child}` (the id of one of this component's slot children). AUTHORITATIVE when present: a reader that honours it paints the entries in order and MUST NOT paint `text` as well, NOR paint a referenced child a second time from the sibling walk; children NOT referenced here still render, after the runs, in sibling order. A reader that ignores it keeps painting `text` then the children — the pre-wave-32 (lossy) result, which is why this key is additive and not a break. `child` ids are NOT validated against the document here (the converter never resolves them); a dangling id is a renderer-side warn-and-skip, mirroring the dangling-slot rule.

text.description: One anonymous inline text run, already through the extractor's character-reference decode + CSS Text §4.1 white-space step. Whitespace at a run boundary is MEANINGFUL (it is the inter-run word space), so only the FIRST run is leading-trimmed and only the LAST run trailing-trimmed — the same trim the whole-element `text` gets, applied to the ends of the sequence rather than to every entry.

child.description: The AUTHORING KEY of one of this component's children — the map key the producer assigned, which survives onto the v2 wire as that child's `name` (schema/spec/03-children.md §5 rule 1). Deliberately NOT the `id`: the converter MINTS ids ('<lowercased-name>-<NNN>') at the flatten boundary, so an id written by the producer would name nothing after the hop, whereas the authoring key round-trips unchanged. Readers resolve against the child's `name` first and MAY fall back to `id` (in the extractor-direct pipeline, which skips the converter, the two are the same string). Marks WHERE in the inline flow that child box sits.

slot.description: Child→parent composition reference — one of the two frozen v2 placement structures (with meta). STRUCTURAL data that MUST round-trip through every reader (NOT underscore-prefixed by rule: `_` is reserved for droppable hints). Lives only on the CHILD; containers carry zero knowledge of their arrivals. Omitted for roots. Consumers: composers only (preview harness / SDUI shell) — style engines MUST ignore slot by contract. A valid v2 document may carry no slot fields at all (Mode B: composition supplied externally). Dangling slot.parent (no component with that id) → composer treats the entry as a root and warns; duplicate ids are already a convert-time error.

parent.description: The id of the container component this component composes into.

name.description: Slot name within the parent. Omitted on the wire when it equals the default 'content'; reserved for future multi-slot containers (scaffold header/body/footer).

property.description: The {type, data} property envelope — byte-identical semantics to v1 (converter/src/main/kotlin/app/irmodels/IRPropertySerializer.kt). 'type' is the IR type name with the 'Property' suffix stripped. 'data' remains deliberately permissive at v2 for the 550-property value surface (documented in schema/spec/02-values.md); readers MUST tolerate unknown 'type' values by skipping the property with a logged warning (spec 05).

selector.description: IRSelector — unchanged from v1: condition is the selector WITHOUT the leading colon (':hover' is stored as 'hover').

keyframeSet.description: One named keyframe set: the stop list, SORTED ascending by offset (stable — equal offsets keep authoring order, mirroring the css-animations-1 §4.2 last-wins cascade). Never empty: the converter drops sets with zero valid stops rather than emitting an unanimatable shell.

keyframeStop.description: One keyframe stop. `offset` is the RESOLVED fractional position (authored 'from'/'0%' → 0, 'to'/'100%' → 1, '50%' → 0.5 — css-animations-1 §4.2 keyframe selectors). `properties` carries the stop's declarations as standard {type,data} property envelopes — the exact same typed pipeline as component base properties (colors → sRGB floats, lengths → px). Which property types interpolate (the animatable tier) and how is the runtimes' contract, spec 07 §2/§3; the wire just carries typed values.

media.description: IRMedia — unchanged from v1: query is the raw media query string, e.g. '(min-width: 768px)'.
